fichas.title: Reed thatching
fichas.summary: Reed thatch is fixed to battens with the ends upward. The reference gives its length, batten spacing, covering thickness, and a service-life estimate that varies by climate.

dimensions.label: Reed length
dimensions.context: Length of reed used for thatching.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 1.2-1.4 m long

dimensions.label: Batten spacing
dimensions.context: Spacing of battens supporting reed thatch.
dimensions.ocr_raw:
spacing
20-30 em

dimensions.label: Thatch thickness
dimensions.context: Minimum thickness; the text recommends a greater thickness of 35–40 cm.
dimensions.ocr_raw: in a thickness of ii;;28 em

dimensions.label: Recommended thatch thickness
dimensions.context: Better thickness for reed thatch.
dimensions.ocr_raw: (better 35-40 em)

dimensions.label: Service life in sunny districts
dimensions.context: Estimated lifetime in sunny districts.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Lifetime in sunny districts 60--70 years

dimensions.label: Roof covering load
dimensions.context: Load of reed thatch.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Reed thatch, load 0.70 KN/m

fichas.title: Wood shingle roof
fichas.summary: Wood shingles may be made from several timber species and are suitable for different kinds of roofs. Their service life depends on material quality and treatment, precipitation, and roof pitch; the text states a rule of thumb relating slope degrees to years of life.

dimensions.label: Roof covering load
dimensions.context: Load of a wood shingle roof.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Wood shingle roof, load 0.25 KN/m

dimensions.label: Roof slope to service-life rule
dimensions.context: The text says degrees of roof slope equal years of lifetime; this records the printed relationship, not a calculated service life.
dimensions.ocr_raw:
degrees of roof slope= years
of lifetime

fichas.title: Slate roof coverings
fichas.summary: Slate is used for roof and wall coverings in several named slating styles. The reference describes boarding, plank width, roofing felt, lap, and pitches for particular slate patterns; it also identifies several slate load values.
